args: Acceptance regression test with Historian disabled. Use this exact sequential sequence, one tool call per model step: read fixture.txt once; ctx_reduce the actual tag on that read result; ctx_expand that tag; ctx_reduce that SAME tag again; ctx_expand that SAME tag again. Do not reread or use any other tools. Report each actual result honestly, especially whether the second restore succeeds or is refused. Do not infer success just because reduce says queued.
